en: As mentioned earlier in this section, you
will most likely need a paid subscription to
use Codex efficiently.
And each subscription tier comes with a
different amount of usage. You can always
check how much usage remains
in the native app by going to this dropdown
here at the bottom and then under Rate
Limits Remaining, you can see your remaining
usage for your 5-hour window and your weekly
window. These are the 2 usage windows
tracked by Codex by OpenAI,
and in the Codex CLI, you can use
/status to get an overview of how much of
your available usage was already used up by
you. And of course, the limits, the time
windows, that may all change over time, but
this is how you can get some insights into
what's remaining.
In the IDE integration, it's also here at
the bottom left, this dropdown, just as in
the native app.
